title: fix: normalize paths in js test cases for consistent handling on Windows
author: Jungzl
summary: Test-only: normalizes the keys of the in-memory filesystem map in node/test/bundle.test.mjs, so the existing `inMemoryFs.get(path.normalize(file))` lookups match on Windows. A no-op on POSIX.
evidence: Master node/test/bundle.test.mjs still builds the map with raw 'hello/world.css' keys (lines 44-47, 95-98) while looking up `path.normalize(file)` (lines 53, 104), which gives 'hello\\world.css' on Windows; these are the two failing tests listed in #541. On Linux/macOS `path.normalize` leaves the keys unchanged, so it can't break CI. Context lines still match master. (#544 tried the same thing in 2023 and was closed without comment.)
